synopsis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 supports architecture descriptions with multiple views tailored to the viewer’s role, rather than one universal diagram [f9886, f15351]. Chapter 12 places it alongside the 4+1 view model, C4 model and SysML as support for this approach [f9886]. The booklet applies the standard to the simulation toolchain by marking elements as real, modeled, emulated or substituted [f15352]. For presenting the plan, Chapter 12 recommends a 2–3-page target capability and architecture section, using ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 as a template or source [f10160].

relations.note: Both describe role-matched architectural views instead of one universal diagram.
Adds the booklet’s simulation-toolchain application and element classifications.
Role-matched architectural detail provides a rationale for using the standard in the plan.
Supplies a concrete toolchain application for the recommended architecture source.
